manifest.OpenIDE-Module-Long-Description:
NetBeans wrapper module that provides to NetBeans plug-ins top quality FX libraries and components without the need of Netbeans JavaFX for Linux/Windows/Mac.

In particular:

  • JavaFX v21.0.11
    • org.javafx:javafx-base
    • org.javafx:javafx-controls
    • org.javafx:javafx-fxml
    • org.javafx:javafx-graphics
    • org.javafx:javafx-media
    • org.javafx:javafx-swingv
  • FormsFX v26.0.3
    • ste.github.stefanofornari:formsfx
  • PreferencesFX v26.0.4
    • ste.github.stefanofornari:preferencesfx
  • ControlsFX v26.0.3
    • org.controlsfx:controlsfx
  • AnimateFX v1.2.4
    • io.github.typhon0.AnimateFX
  • Ikonli Icons Pack v12.4.0
    • org.kordamp.ikonli:ikonly-core
    • org.kordamp.ikonli:ikonli-material2-pack
    • org.kordamp.ikonli:ikonli-bootstrapicons-pack
    • org.kordamp.ikonli:ikonli-javafx
  • AtlantaFX v2.1.0
    • io.github.mkpaz:atlantafx-base
